boundaries.endpoint: all direct utility reference pages plus special builtins and enumerated shell-language leaf topics

every direct leaf in the official HTML table of contents, every entry in the official shell-builtin index, and every explicitly enumerated embedded extension below; POSIX-overlapping semantics deduplicated to POSIX IDs

exactly the six stable IDs listed in frozenSelectors.ubuntuReleaseNoteIds

boundaries.category: Debian traceroute alternative matching the Ubuntu package version

canonicalization.rule: A POSIX utility or special builtin owns same-name Ubuntu implementations and POSIX-equivalent Bash builtins; an explicitly declared Ubuntu provider command owns its package alternative; mapfile owns readarray.
